brainlife.readme:
to be edited

**Use for:** Projecting out ECG, EOG or environmental noise from raw MEG/EEG.

**Not for:** Recordings from another system or sensor layout.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 4 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.projection.json
